source_evidence: PLAYER exact: "Tell them the nature of my business and my invitation details" at DAY289~13:00 Nightglass Hall OUTER ENTRANCE/estate lane after road arrival. User explicitly authorizes V to explain his identity, purpose and actual invitation correspondence to the Hall PORTER in ordinary polite terms, without automatically entering the Hall, accepting any new quest, requesting access to the heart itself, publicly displaying Kestrel proof, confessing things, or committing V to unrelated speech. SOURCE LIMITS verified from campaign/continuity/quests.md Day275 provenance conversation, prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md current Nightglass chapter, archive/continuity/session-log-day246-correspondence-retro-closed.md, campaign/continuity/inventory.md: V previously visited Nightglass and personally met LORD SEVERIN and long-term STEWARD EDRIC VALE, observed silver-veined HEART in Severin's reliquary, was told purported Verdana history and heard subjective words "My child" in older real scene, none proves identity. Edric independently authored DAY218 additional CONSERVATIVE courtesy invitation to supervised access to existing NON-SENSITIVE Hall inventories/steward notes; it was forwarded Eastwatch and received at BLACKTHORN by DAY243, addressed to V but remains physically HELD and UNREAD by V in Tamsin's mail packet, no appointment booked, original letter NOT in V baggage; prior Lord Severin original Day39 neutral reply to V's Day22 letter is separate, also held at Blackthorn and not ancestry proof. Player asks to convey 'invitation details' so V describes known scope without pretending to have read full letter or quoting text he has never opened. The actual specific ordinary dialogue V elects to transmit is only summarized content of player's requested business: 'I am Valenthia of House Vaishnavi, previously a visitor of Lord Severin and acquaintance of Edric Vale. I have returned to learn the silver-veined heart's recovery provenance, its alleged connection to Verdana and whether Hall records can establish anything about my House and past. A letter from Master Vale came to my household offering supervised review of existing inventories and steward records, but that original is at Blackthorn and I have not brought/read it. Please announce me to Master Vale and Lord Severin if he is available.' This is a user-directed speech act, not DM selecting V's future promises, ancestry verdict or an invitation V already accepted. No Kestrel original bureaucratic directive or its contents shared with porter; no reliquary access demanded. PORTER is independent ordinary Hall household staff at visible outer entrance; he recognizes the House name as a plausible prior guest, neither vouches yet for identity nor has personal knowledge of private Edric letter/research. Responds he can convey V's name/request to Master Vale, check the Hall's visitor records, welcome party to ordinary public reception waiting area and water the horses in yard, without automatic fee or security confrontation. PORTER steps inside to ANNOUNCE V; no immediate arrival/appearance or confirmation of Edric or Severin, no story secret, letter, permission or long-term guest hospitality determined. Scene clock ~DAY28913:05, V+companions remain on Hall forecourt/at coach doorway facing invited entry, NEXT V may take the offered waiting room or another deliberate course; messenger response not yet returned. Existing sources hold HALL plans and prior relationship, no repeated first encounter or fabricated event. All status unchanged: V HP48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Superiority4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 free Whispers1/1; newly purchased Stone of Good Luck physically V-held but STILL UNATTUNED/no +1 applies; old worn Cloak of Protection attuned. Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 MP6/6 Bestial Soul CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 full spells/CD2, Mara healthy, four owned healthy horses and coach intact. V personal purse329gp1sp6cp, carried rations21/feed28, sealed PixieDust1, LongRest5/6, no qualifying extra rest. Original Kestrel western bureau original directive/2 research orders/transfer ledger/two false admin folios/signed trial injury packet and mage pouch all retained V; Mara Neri interview notes, Fenar padded case six sealed reagent vials and silver precision instrument unappraised. Sedgecross eleven rescued patients under funded fourteen-night care with direct Blackthorn work invitation previously issued, no new care results/personal evidence dissemination to foreign states. No die required for normal prior relationship and ordinary polite introduction, no unchosen resource spend, no damage or loot.
